# ReadAloud AI

> ReadAloud AI turns articles, PDFs, emails, and other documents into natural-sounding audio using AI-powered text-to-speech and voice cloning, so you can listen to your content instead of reading it.

## What it does
- Converts text (articles, PDFs, emails, documents) into speech using AI voices
- Supports voice cloning (up to 10 cloned voices on paid plans)
- Import content directly from a URL
- Adjustable playback speed (up to 3x on paid plans)
- Available as a web app and an iOS app

## Key pages
- Homepage: https://readaloudai.org/
- Web app: https://readaloudai.org/app
- Privacy policy: https://readaloudai.org/privacy
- Terms of service: https://readaloudai.org/terms
- iOS App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/readaloud-ai/id6757346255

## Pricing
- Free plan: 5 articles/month, 10 AI voices, standard quality audio
- Pro Weekly: $5.59/week — unlimited articles, 50+ AI voices, HD audio, voice cloning, PDF import
- Pro Yearly: $27.99/year — everything in Pro Weekly plus unlimited voice clones

## Who it's for
People who want to listen to written content (articles, PDFs, emails, documents) rather than read it — including for accessibility, multitasking, or commuting.
